map.逐项判定：绝缘电阻≥500MΩ、体积电阻率≥1×10¹⁴Ω·m、耐压≥35kV；: Item-by-item: insulation resistance ≥ 500 MΩ, volume resistivity ≥ 1×10¹⁴ Ω·m, withstand voltage ≥ 35 kV; all three satisfied = pass. Insufficient voltage breaks down under HV; insufficient resistivity leaks greatly.
map.绝缘电阻 550MΩ（≥500 ✓）、体积电阻率 1.5×10¹⁴Ω·m（≥1: Insulation resistance 550 MΩ (≥500 ✓), volume resistivity 1.5×10¹⁴ Ω·m (≥1 ✓), withstand voltage 38 kV (≥35 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If voltage drops to 32 kV it fails, breakdown risk.
map.35kV 耐压什么水平？: What level is 35 kV withstand voltage?
map.对应 35kV 等级设备的工频耐压示例值，实际须按设备额定电压与交接/预防性试验: It is an example power-frequency withstand value for 35 kV-class equipment; actual must follow the equipment's rated voltage and handover/preventive test code (e.g., DL/T).
map.为何绝缘电阻要求 500MΩ 这么高？: Why is insulation resistance required as high as 500 MΩ?
map.高压设备绝缘裕度大、泄漏电流须极小；500MΩ 为示例下限，更高电压等级要求更高: HV equipment needs large insulation margin and minimal leakage current; 500 MΩ is an example lower limit — higher voltage classes require higher.
map.耐压试验需逐级加压至试验电压: Withstand-voltage tests require stepwise pressurization to test voltage
